svg.aria-label: Closing with the negative cap and crimping: press the negative cap with gasket onto the spring, sitting level, without squeezing out the gasket. Following the crimper instructions, place the cell in the CR2032 die, apply the set pressure and hold for a few seconds.

text.style: fill:rgb(19, 28, 38);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700

svg.text: Add cap; crimp in the die
